recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it is a narrow source fix completing the Published issue without changing Coverage semantics beyond making the Event classification and link text consistent.
issue_request: FHIR-17951 was a Published/Persuasive FM change request asking to add that Coverage is an Event-style workflow resource and include the workflow link.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged Coverage commit 288d1e5047c9743642f053c3b5099e6bfd882d60, merged by 96468a3c248450e49dca549c7d56182237abcaf7, added the Coverage introduction sentence and linked to workflow.html#event, but left the visible label as "Workflow Request."
additional_context: Coverage is active in source/fhir.ini and its StructureDefinition maps the resource to the workflow Event pattern. Neighboring Event resource pages use Event/Workflow Event wording for the same workflow anchor. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence. FHIR-17944 and FHIR-17950 appeared in the same 2018 Coverage commit but concern separate terminology and boundaries-section requests, so they were not decided.
reconciliation: Changed source/coverage/coverage-introduction.xml to say Coverage is an "event" resource and to label the workflow.html#event link as "Workflow Event."
source_changes: source/coverage/coverage-introduction.xml: corrected the Coverage workflow sentence from `a "event" ... Workflow Request` to `an "event" ... Workflow Event`.
